bio.text: Belinda Fox-Spencer is the Constitution Party nominee for West Virginia's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballot Access News.

In 2022 she ran for the same district as an independent; according to her campaign website, as reported by WCHS that year, she is from Monroe County and is a small business owner who worked in health care for 20 years as a diagnostic medical sonographer.

sources.title: Belinda Fox-Spencer, Independent, W.Va. 1st Congressional District Candidate
